items.q: What do I get today, and what is still coming?
items.a: Today: the Opportunity Inbox (restock, win-back, dues, dead stock), smart Goals with pace and daily targets, a month-end forecast, and analytics. Coming next: Ask POS-sible, the Business Health Score, customer lifecycle and experiments.

items.q: How does it know what to suggest?
items.a: It reads your own sales, stock, customers and dues, and applies plain rules such as sales speed against stock on hand. Nothing is guessed from other shops.

items.q: How much history does it need?
items.a: A few weeks of sales is enough for restock and dues. Win-back and forecasts get sharper as you add more months.
Every sale, purchase and expense posts to double-entry books, so the insights and your accounts come from the same figures.
Cash, card, bank transfer, cheque, bKash, Nagad, Rocket and Upay. You can split one bill across several methods.

items.q: Does it work in Bangla, and with several branches?
items.a: Yes to both. Every screen is in English and বাংলা, and stock is tracked per branch with transfers between them.

items.q: Is my data separate from other shops?
items.a: Yes. Every shop's data is kept apart from every other shop's.
